haloPotentialGradient.scope: Finite differences with h<0.005 kpc at radii beyond 200 kpc; only halo component, excludes coarse vertical differencing of disk.

regression.scope: Only diagnostic clock and analytic potential reference corrected. Initial particle phase arrays, masses and force shaders identical.

limitations: No snapshot of the specific 35200-Myr case
CPU control runs have N<=1760, no demonstrated collisionless limit
Only three seeds; scatter is descriptive
Small epsilon at fixed dt is not jointly converged
Jeans/local Gaussian closure is not a validated stationary DF
No long high-N matched CPU/GPU study; energy maxima depend on sampling cadence
Fixed analytic field controls deliberately omit response and granularity, cannot isolate causal percentages
